instructions: For one user story and one acceptance criterion, decide whether the criterion verifies the story. Choose verifies only when the criterion's observable result directly covers the story; choose unrelated when it does not; choose unsure when the text leaves the relationship unresolved.

labels.name: verifies
labels.description: The acceptance criterion directly verifies the user story.
examples: A story asks for a gap flag and the criterion observes the exact gap label.
A story asks for a changed base to replace labels and the criterion observes old labels disappearing and new labels appearing.

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: The acceptance criterion does not verify the user story.
examples: A story asks for reading view dimming and the criterion only checks comment movement.
A story asks for records without source text and the criterion only checks a visual badge.

labels.name: unsure
labels.description: The text does not provide enough evidence to decide whether the criterion verifies the user story.
examples: The story and criterion use related terms but leave the observable relationship implicit.
The criterion names a result without enough detail to tell whether it covers the story's scope.
